officialDocs.label: Content Posting API: Direct Post (audit rules)

verdict.summary: You can build and test in a sandbox with a handful of invited TikTok accounts, but real users can only connect after TikTok approves the app and each product (Login Kit, Display API, Content Posting API). Posting has a second, separate content audit: until it passes, every post your agent publishes is forced to private, and posts made before the audit stay private afterwards.

evidence.label: inferred
evidence.note: Register, create the app, add products and scopes, enable sandbox, invite test accounts and run the flow. Based on a third-party guide, since TikTok's developer site was unreachable from our network.

timeToProd.assumes: An app that reads the user's profile and videos (user.info.basic, video.list). Public posting (video.publish) adds the content audit at the long end. Read-only apps sit at the short end.
timeToProd.waitingOn: TikTok app/product review (third parties report about 1–2 weeks for a clean submission). Then, for posting, the Content Posting audit (reported as weeks).

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: We found no official review SLA. Durations come from vendor guides.

prerequisites.item: A TikTok for Developers account and an app with the products you need (Login Kit plus Display API and/or Content Posting API)
prerequisites.why: Scopes are tied to products, and each product needs approval.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: The Display API guide says you need approval for both Login Kit and the API product. Text seen in a search excerpt, because the page was unreachable for us.

prerequisites.item: A public website, privacy policy and terms of service that load and describe how TikTok content is used
prerequisites.why: Reviewers reject submissions whose policy pages don't load or don't explain data use.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Vendor guides.

prerequisites.item: A demo video showing login, consent and every requested scope in use
prerequisites.why: Missing demo coverage of a scope is a common rejection reason.

evidence.label: unverified

prerequisites.item: Verified domains, if you post with PULL_FROM_URL

scopeTiers.impact: video.upload sends drafts to the creator's inbox. video.publish posts directly. Until the content audit passes, all posts are private (SELF_ONLY), and posting to a public account fails with unaudited_client_can_only_post_to_private_accounts.

evidence.label: sourced

steps.title: Register on TikTok for Developers
steps.detail: Sign up at developers.tiktok.com and create or join an organization.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: The site timed out from our network, so we couldn't observe the flow.

steps.title: Create the app and add products and scopes
steps.detail: Add Login Kit and the API products you need (Display API, Content Posting API), tick only the scopes your demo will show, and register the redirect URI(s).

steps.title: Enable sandbox and invite test accounts
steps.detail: Create a sandbox and add the TikTok accounts you'll test with (reported limit: 10 per sandbox).

steps.title: Implement Login Kit OAuth and token refresh
steps.detail: Send users to the authorize page with client_key, scope (comma-separated), response_type=code, redirect_uri and state. Exchange the code at POST https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/oauth/token/ (form-encoded). Refresh the 24 h access token with grant_type=refresh_token, and store the returned refresh token, which may change.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: The token endpoint was live-checked. The authorize URL (https://www.tiktok.com/v2/auth/authorize/) timed out from our network.

steps.title: Build the posting UX to audit standards
steps.detail: Call creator_info when the composer opens and only offer the privacy levels and interaction settings it returns. Add a review screen confirming caption, privacy and settings before publishing. Handle spam_risk_* errors without retrying.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Audit expectations come from a vendor guide.

steps.title: Draft the submission and demo script
steps.detail: Write the app description, a justification per scope tied to demo timestamps, and a data-handling statement, and check that the privacy and terms pages describe TikTok data use.

steps.title: Record the demo and submit for review
steps.detail: Record a narrated video of login, consent, each scope in use and (for posting) the post appearing, then submit the app for review in the portal.

steps.title: App and product review
steps.detail: TikTok checks purpose, security and data use. Third parties report about 1–2 weeks for a clean first submission.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: No official SLA found.

steps.title: Content Posting audit (only if posting)
steps.detail: After the integration works, submit for the content audit to lift the private-only restriction. Do it before onboarding customers, because posts made while unaudited stay private.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: The audit requirement is official. The timing and 'stays private' behaviour come from a vendor guide.

agentCanDo: Implement Login Kit OAuth and the refresh scheduler
Draft scope justifications and the demo script
Check privacy and terms pages cover TikTok data use
humanMustDo: Register and create the app in the developer portal
Submit for app review and the content audit

blockers.symptom: Posts succeed but are only visible to the creator
blockers.cause: The client hasn't passed the Content Posting audit, so all content is restricted to private viewing.
blockers.fix: Submit for the audit. Don't promise public posting until it passes.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: Via a search excerpt of TikTok's Direct Post reference.

blockers.cause: An unaudited client tried to post to a public account.
blockers.fix: Pass the content audit, or test with private accounts.

blockers.cause: The refresh token expired (365 days after issue), was replaced by a newer one, or the user revoked access.
blockers.fix: Always store the latest returned refresh token, and send the user back through login.

blockers.symptom: Calls fail about a day after connecting
blockers.fix: Refresh proactively before expires_in runs out.

blockers.cause: Scopes beyond what the demo shows, a demo that skips login or the post appearing, or policy pages that don't load.
blockers.fix: Trim scopes, narrate a complete demo, and fix the policy pages.

blockers.cause: Posting frequency, or duplicate or watermarked content. Third parties report a 25 posts/day per-account cap.
blockers.fix: Don't retry. Throttle posting per creator.

nuances.text: Access tokens last 24 hours. Refresh tokens last 365 days from initial issue, and a refresh can return a different refresh token.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: Via a search excerpt of TikTok's token docs.

nuances.text: TikTok uses client_key (not client_id), comma-separated scopes, and a form-encoded token endpoint that rejects other content types.

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: POST without a form Content-Type returned 'Please set Content-Type header to application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

nuances.text: Users can grant some scopes and decline others, so read the scope field in the token response before calling the APIs.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Third-party guidance.

nuances.text: Upload initiation is reportedly limited to 6 requests/min per user token. App-level limits aren't published.
TikTok's own web properties (developers.tiktok.com, www.tiktok.com) timed out or refused connections from our research network, while open.tiktokapis.com answered. Availability may depend on region.

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: Observed on 2026-10-20. It could be a local network issue.
